ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... The goose keeps its things in locker 1. ... The ant keeps its things in locker 8. ... The cow keeps its things in locker 3. ... Which locker belongs to the animal known for honking?" -> answer org 1; the alt prompt asks about the cow (bridge alt), its 3rd statement. Possible answers after the patch: 3 (answer of bridge alt's statement), 8 (answer at the same statement slot), 9 (the alt prompt's own answer), 1 (answer org kept).
